seo_title: Alabama Scholarships for High School Seniors

intro: Finding financial support for college can be a challenge, especially for high school seniors in Alabama. This collection features 4 scholarships specifically tailored for students in your state, with award amounts ranging from approximately $1,000 to $7,000. Each opportunity has its own requirements and deadlines, so it's essential to review the details carefully to identify which ones align with your goals and timeline.
